text:
Tall red achiras

—I know with what blood reddened—

in the courtyard of the 5th,

flowering.

Above, in blue sky,

indifferent,

and deaf and mute and blind,

as always.

Below, the prison

and your wounds,

falling drop by drop

on the achiras.

And outside and in us

the seed,

the truth of its strength,

as always.

translation.title: Tall Red Achiras...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps achiras as the named flower and ties their redness to prison blood and enduring seed.
